examples.en: The moon is really pretty today.
I made a wish while looking at the moon.
A rabbit lives in the moon.
I can see neither stars nor the moon today.

examples.ko: 어제 처음으로 달에 가는 영화를 봤어요.
examples.en: Yesterday I saw a movie about going to the moon for the first time.
That moon is bigger than last night.

explain: '달'은 '해'와 짝으로 자주 나와요. 같은 '달'이 '한 달, 두 달'처럼 월(month)을 세는 말도 되는데, '달이 뜨다/지다'와 함께 나오면 하늘의 달이에요. 둥근 달은 '보름달', 가늘게 휜 달은 '초승달'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: When evening comes, the moon rises in the sky.
phrases.nuance_ko: 밤에 달이 하늘에 나타날 때 쓴다.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the moon appears in the night sky.

explain_en: '달' often appears as a pair with '해' (sun). The same word also counts months, as in '한 달', but with '달이 뜨다/지다' it is the moon in the sky. A full moon is '보름달' and a thin crescent is '초승달'.

examples.en: In autumn, we pick up chestnuts in the mountains.
Boiled chestnuts are sweet and tasty.

examples.ko: 할머니가 밤 한 봉지를 사 오셨어요.
examples.en: Grandmother bought a bag of chestnuts.
This cake has chestnuts in it.
I like chestnuts and I like sweet potatoes.

explain: 밤은 가을에 먹는 열매예요. 구운 밤은 '군밤', 삶은 밤은 '삶은 밤'이라고 해요. '밤(night)'과 글자가 같아서 '먹다, 가을, 껍질'이 같이 나오면 열매예요.

phrases.en: In winter, I buy and eat roasted chestnuts on the street.
phrases.nuance_ko: 겨울에 길거리에서 파는 구운 밤을 말할 때 쓴다.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the roasted chestnuts sold on the street in winter.

explain_en: It is a nut you eat in autumn. Roasted ones are '군밤' and boiled ones are '삶은 밤'. It is spelled the same as '밤' (night), so words like eat, autumn or shell tell you it is the chestnut.
